name: Divvy Up
description: A full-stack expense-sharing app for creating groups, tracking shared expenses, and calculating who owes whom. Built as a monorepo for an Advanced Web Technologies course.

name: Diary App
description: A full-stack diary app with user authentication and CRUD functionality for creating, editing, and managing private journal entries.

name: Anonymous Notes
description: A MERN-stack platform where users can create accounts and anonymously share thoughts, feelings, and personal notes.

name: Halalsters
description: A responsive single-page website built for a small homemade food business to showcase its menu, services, and offerings.

name: SA Accounting & Tax Solutions
description: A responsive single-page business website I made for my dad and his friend's accounting and tax service, showcasing its services and providing visitors with an easy way to get in touch.

name: Developer Showcase
description: A full-stack developer community for showcasing projects, requesting feedback, recruiting collaborators, and connecting with other builders. Built with raw PostgreSQL queries to strengthen my SQL and relational database design skills.

name: Tale Weaver
description: A real-time collaborative role-playing platform where users can post story ideas, connect with writers, and turn responses into live role-play conversations with notifications.

name: Case By Case
description: A courtroom-themed educational game made in my Educational Game Development class that teaches introductory CS students how to identify effective test cases, uncover bugs, and understand why good software testing matters.
